description: Verification of pre-draft abstract key numbers for per-hue hV4 LOCO CVD statistics

predraft_claim.text: Fig 2: hV4 LOCO HC p=0.044; CVD failure at blue (d=1.37, p=0.046), purple (d=1.54, p=0.060)

HC_hV4_LOCO_group_perm_p.source: results_streamlined.tex L81; phase_a_2component HC group permutation

sub_08.note: p_one ≈ 0.046 matches pre-draft, but d_cohens=2.133 ≠ pre-draft 1.37

sub_09.note: p_one ≈ 0.046 matches pre-draft, but d_cohens=2.149 ≠ pre-draft 1.37

sub_08.note: p_two=0.066 close to pre-draft 0.060; d_cohens=2.398 ≠ pre-draft 1.54

sub_09.note: p=0.54 — completely inconsistent with pre-draft p=0.060

full_per_hue_statistics.formula: Crawford-Howell modified t: t = (x_cvd - hc_mean) / (hc_sd * sqrt((n+1)/n)); df=n-1=6; d_cohens = |x_cvd - hc_mean| / hc_sd

p_values.blue_p046: sub-09 blue p_one=0.046 MATCHES pre-draft. sub-08 blue p_one=0.047 also close.
p_values.purple_p060: sub-08 purple p_two=0.066 is the closest match; pre-draft p=0.060 is between p_one=0.033 and p_two=0.066. sub-09 purple p=0.54 — no match.
p_values.conclusion: p-values are approximately reproducible for sub-09 blue (one-tailed) and sub-08 purple (two-tailed or marginal). The pre-draft appears to have mixed one-tailed and two-tailed thresholds.

d_values.mismatch: Cohen's d from per_color_breakdown gives d=2.1-2.4 for blue/purple. Pre-draft claims d=1.37/1.54.
possible_explanations: Pre-draft used a different effect size formula (e.g., Hedges' g with small-sample correction factor ~0.87 does not explain the gap: 2.13×0.87=1.85≠1.37)
Pre-draft values may be from an older analysis script with different HC baseline set (e.g., excluding sub-07 with only 16 hV4 voxels)
Pre-draft may have used a group-average CVD metric (mean of sub-08 + sub-09) rather than individual Crawford-Howell
Pre-draft 'd' may refer to |t_CH| = 1.99-2.01 for blue — still not 1.37
Values may be from the loco_srm-based analysis (SRM-projected) rather than loco_reinforcement (voxel-space)

blue.recommendation: Use sub-09 blue: p=0.046 (one-tailed Crawford-Howell), d=2.15. Report d as Cohen's d not 1.37.

verdict.status: PRE-DRAFT VALUES NOT REPRODUCIBLE AS STATED
verdict.action: DO NOT add pre-draft d=1.37/d=1.54 values to manuscript without identifying source script and reconfirming. The p-values (0.046 for blue, ~0.060 for purple) are approximately reproducible, but d values differ substantially. The canonical data supports reporting: sub-09 blue p=0.046 (one-tailed CH), sub-08 purple p=0.066 (two-tailed CH). The d values to report are ~2.1-2.4, not 1.37/1.54.
verdict.recommended_update_to_predraft: Revise pre-draft §4 abstract key numbers: 'CVD failure at blue (d=2.15, p=0.046 one-tailed, sub-09; Crawford-Howell), purple (d=2.40, p=0.066 two-tailed, sub-08)' OR use only p-values and describe direction (both subjects below HC range at blue).
